findings.title: Repeated negative implicit probes
findings.remaining: Wrapper still costs more than direct DOPRI; limit exploration before paying for it.

findings.title: Initial transient evidence used beyond its cost regime
findings.mechanism: Endpoint relaxation reserves the next eligible same-checkpoint prefix; immediate replay of the previous mixed-regime prefix is avoided.

findings.title: Lifetime probe cap suppresses late stiffness entry
findings.remaining: Finite batch eligibility is not a bounded physical detection delay.

findings.title: Return direction compared against unmatched old costs
findings.result: Same-window implicit replay must support return; a cheaper valid implicit comparator is committed productively. All attempts/fatal paths remain charged.

findings.title: Method/execution decisions need shared physical identity and units
findings.result: Exact model/provider/chart/mesh/norm/tolerance/window/environment versions, qualification and cost units are checked before a conservative arithmetic decision.
findings.remaining: Caller-maintained epochs and supplied cost bounds must be valid; empirical extrema do not certify future costs.

findings.title: Uniform inner-root precision wastes work
findings.remaining: Need real expensive callbacks, settled-prefix reuse and valid provider enclosures; the scalar selects sequential RK.

findings.title: Algebraic/causal/Fourier providers not integrated into one general selector
Execution calibration cannot be recovered on short horizons
findings.result: All three calibration-inclusive phases exceed the strongest directly configured execution alternative. Drift detection and parity pass.

findings.title: General physical output/error coverage remains incomplete
findings.result: New pilots assess full-state endpoints, not broad continuous-output, event, nonnormal, mass-matrix or global-error qualification.

findings.title: Unavailable optional implicit provider can reject a valid explicit problem
Measured work score is not provider-independent elapsed cost
findings.result: RHS/JVP/solve work weighting and empirical time envelopes require declared scope. No measured statistical false-positive-rate reduction is asserted.

findings.title: Public Rust configuration and enum additions require downstream migration
findings.result: Default numerical behaviour is unchanged; external exhaustive struct literals and enum matches may require new fields or arms. Repository callers use struct-update/factory forms; external downstream compilation was not performed.
